title: Infer a phase change from two paths
statement:
Producing liquid Y by a reaction releases 260 kJ. Producing the same amount of gaseous Y from the same reactants releases 230 kJ. What is the heat for vaporizing that amount of Y?

[_]{a}

explanations: Gas relative to liquid is higher by 30 kJ.
The steps have opposite directions for the shared reactants.

hints: Use the same starting reactants as a shared state.
solution: Combine reverse liquid production with forward gas production. The result is +260−230=+30 kJ.
